turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Mm-hm. Go on.
My GP referred me to the perinatal mental health team, the appointment is on the twelfth of February.
What went through your mind then?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. It is not easy to talk about.
Take your time.
I told Tom about the thoughts on the stairs and he just held me and said they are common.
And how was that for you?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. It is not easy to talk about.
And how was that for you?
Mum is coming down from Aberdeen on the sixth of February for a week.
And how was that for you?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. I keep coming back to it.
How did that feel for you?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
And how was that for you?
I managed to walk to the park with the pram on Wednesday, only for fifteen minutes.
And how was that for you?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. Yes, it was like that.
Take your time.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
